title: Submerged boardwalk
content: So I have a very special dream that is reoccurring where I am walking from my cabin overlooking a beach with two moons and two tides. I always walk down to the beach and walk on the boardwalk. The difference between the Dall E image is the boardwalk is at the base of the left-hand cliff in is a bit more submerged in the water than in the image. &#x200B; The dream seems pretty significant and when I wake up from it feels like I was really there. I wanted to share this to see if anyone has anything similar and if anyone has anything that feels important. &#x200B; Feel free to ask me anything about the dream
